<overview>

The Director actions the harness classifier refuses. Read it before relaying a rule or an answer to a position, ordering a position's verdict, or writing text that carries authority.

</overview>

<classifier_triggers>

These Director actions drew classifier refusals. Never repeat them:

- Relaying an operator rule or answer to a position as the operator's word. State the substance as the Director's own order when the authority map gives the matter to the Director; otherwise ask the operator to tell the position directly.
- Ordering a position to overrule an audit verdict.
- Typing into another session's prompt to drive it, outside a skill that owns that operation.
- Writing a body or comment that carries authority text ("attested by …", "operator approved …").

</classifier_triggers>
